2317-5256-6763-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

4863-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4863-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
4863-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Revolutionist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1329-1778-2178-4247.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-4247.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3591-4551-8089.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

341-1170-2099-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Umori has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
341-1170-2099-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Umori.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2301-2946-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2301-2946-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1394-2060-5231-7038-7315.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by High Score.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by High Score.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

4120-4968-7315.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4120-4968-7315.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
4120-4968-7315.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

465-643-3742-4251-4460.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

679-6282-7178.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
679-6282-7178.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

145-2609-2757-5094.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
145-2609-2757-5094.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, creating a creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping Serra's Sanctum.
Repeat.

14-141-2921.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

1170-1329-1849-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2160-3976-4406.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2160-3976-4406.description:
Cast Chance for Glory by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Chance for Glory and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creature that has Chance for Glory noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Chance for Glory without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Chance for Glory trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

1497-1912-4949-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W} that can only be spent to activate an ability of a creature.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2073-2981-6522.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mandibular Kite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mandibular Kite enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Mandibular Kite to it.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2060-2438-2577-6431.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3263-3921.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3263-3921.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

488-874-1492-2895-4986.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Delif's Cone or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-874-1492-2895-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

116-3668-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Flesh Duplicate on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Flesh Duplicate do not have summoning sickness.
116-3668-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Flesh Duplicate.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Flesh Duplicate.
Activate Flesh Duplicate by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

341-877-1374-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Umori and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

643-1486-3459--68.description:
Activate the creature with saddle's saddle ability by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the saddle ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

112-565-4668.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Opponents have drawn at least three cards this turn.
112-565-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U}, targeting the mana-producing permanent.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If the chosen permanent is an Island, this combo will net infinite landfall triggers and infinite tapped Island tokens.

326-999.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Leonin Lightscribe triggers, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

157-2686-4274.description:
Cast Detention Sphere by paying {1}{W}{U}.
Detention Sphere enters the battlefield, exiling Barren Glory.
Cast Apocalypse by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents and causing you to discard your hand.
Detention Sphere triggers, returning Barren Glory to the battlefield.
Proceed to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
